notes.title: “Lone City” makes its debut — Rebuilding humanity's legend amidst the silent rui
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone, nice to meet you. Thank you for checking out our game.[/b][/p][p]This is [i]Lone City[/i] — a free-to-play post-apocalyptic game inspired by [i]I Am Legend[/i].
It tells the story of a lone survivor, a loyal dog, and a roaring muscle car, struggling to survive in a world where civilization has collapsed.[/p][p]The game will continue to grow with more content over time, and we sincerely look forward to your attention and support.
If you enjoy it, feel free to invite your friends to join you on this journey through the silent ruins of [i]Lone City[/i].[/p][p]World:A vast, perilous post-apocalyptic city awaits your exploration.[/p][p]Survival:Gather resources, cultivate crops, craft food and weapons to endure the wasteland.[/p][p]Shooting:Experience AAA-level first-person shooting with intense combat.[/p][p]Car:Drive and customize various sports cars with realistic physics and stunning skins.[/p][p]Monsters:Face dozens of unique mutated creatures, each with distinct abilities.[/p][p]Building:Construct and personalize your own shelter amidst the ruins.[/p][p]Story:Moral choices between good and evil lie hidden in the wasteland.[/p][p]You're also welcome to check out my other anime-style combat bike game — [b]Rider Valkyries[/b].[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3691920/_/"]Steam 上的 摩托娇娘[/url][/p]
